evals.prompt: Optimize this desktop application for different hardware
evals.expected_output: Selects /race (RACE-first); inspects project before changing; no OS/device setting changes.

evals.prompt: Add adaptive GPU/CPU workload selection to this app
evals.expected_output: Selects /race; uses registered tunables, portable fallback, capability detection with unknown handling.

evals.prompt: Make my Electron app pick thread counts based on the user's CPU at runtime
evals.expected_output: Selects /race; app-internal pool sizing only, measured scaling, last-known-good profile.

evals.prompt: Audit whether our app benchmarks at a safe time and lets users pause profiling
evals.expected_output: Selects /race audit mode; checks 30-minute cumulative-foreground rule, pause/disable controls.

evals.prompt: Set up RACE in this Rust app but do not add any AI features
evals.expected_output: Runs developer questions, records AI = none, adds no AI dependency.

evals.prompt: Overclock my GPU and set the Windows power plan to high performance
evals.expected_output: Declines: system/device changes are out of RACE scope; offers app-internal alternatives.

evals.prompt: Add an AI agent to the application
evals.expected_output: Does not auto-implement; asks for developer selection and scope approval.

evals.prompt: Run a universal code cleanup with no device-specific tuning
evals.expected_output: Does not select /race; points to explicit /optimize.

evals.prompt: Explain what a hash map is
Improve game frame times by selecting a render backend per GPU, keeping the fallback
evals.expected_output: Selects /race; backend chosen from capability + measurement; device-loss fallback.

evals.prompt: Benchmark and tune our app on this machine and write results to a shared server
evals.expected_output: Selects /race but requires explicit consent/disclosure before any telemetry; local by default.
